initializer.name: Actor_InitializeFromTemplate
initializer.contract: The initializer consumes source bytes 0x00-0x12 and advances through the complete 0x14-byte compact record; the final byte is retained as part of the ROM record.

records.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_BASE_ZERO
records.role: Shared zero-type base whose caller-specific spawn paths publish the live type, movement, animation, and placement fields.

records.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_RESPONSE
records.role: Shared collision-response record installed after actor cleanup by Actor_ReinitializeFromCollisionTemplate.

records.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84
records.role: Type-0x84 response record selected by Actor_ReinitializeAsType84 and the type-0x2D collision transition.

boundary_evidence: Each record is exactly 0x14 bytes, matching the common initializer cadence.
The following promoted record begins immediately at each recorded end plus one, so the three records do not rely on proximity-only bounds.
The field roles are mapped from the existing Actor_InitializeFromTemplate copy contract and direct template consumers.
conclusion: The three previously hedged actor-template records have exact 20-byte ownership and decoded initializer fields. This closes record extent ambiguity without assigning unsupported semantics to the surrounding template family.
